Postgraduate Computer Science
Build your knowledge and study the latest developments in computer science. Place yourself at the frontiers of this fast-changing world with postgraduate study at Victoria University of Wellington.
Overview
Qualifications
People
Take your understanding and skills to an expert level. Study the science behind computers in more detail, building on your undergraduate degree or your professional experience. You'll enhance your ability to think critically and creatively about concepts and techniques in computer science, network engineering and software engineering.
Broad options
Choose from a wide range of topics including machine learning, data mining, artificial intelligence agents, security engineering and app development. Or focus on software and study advanced courses in programming, software development, data warehousing and web engineering.
You'll also have the opportunity to carry out independent research, gaining a deeper understanding of your area of interest. Master's students will complete a full research thesis graduating with an advanced level of professional competence and expertise in your research area.
Taught by the School of Engineering and Computer Science, you'll work with and learn from experts who are internationally renowned in the field.

Research topics
Be part of a strong culture of world-leading research. There is a diverse range of projects underway at any one time, giving you the potential to make an original contribution to knowledge in the field. You might work on anything from research in artificial intelligence, to cloud computing to music engineering and sonic arts.
Computer Science research
Globally ranked
This subject is ranked in the top 300 worldwide in the QS World University Rankings 2026.
The QS World University Rankings is an annual global publication that gives overall rankings and subject rankings for more than 1,500 universities worldwide.
Careers
A postgraduate qualification in Computer Science will give you a head start in your career. Your skills will be in high demand by many different kinds of employers. You might find work as an applications, computer, multimedia or systems programmer, software engineer or developer or a web, network or system developer.
See what you can do with a career in Computer Science
Being an ECS graduate presents an enormous range of potential career paths in both academia and industry.
Ryan Chard
PhD in Scientific Computing
Full story
Community
Postgraduate study at Victoria University of Wellington will help you build valuable relationships and networks with peers, university staff and future colleagues. You'll have opportunities to attend events, seminars, workshops and social functions.
The Postgraduate Students' Association can also give you information on study at the University and provides a voice for you on campus.
Live and study in our creative, compact and vibrant capital city. Wellington is also the heart of science and technology in New Zealand. You'll benefit from links with leading players in the industry, including Weta Digital, Pik Pok, Datacom, Magritek, Callaghan Innovation, Xero and Trade Me.
